why: D-Casting is a named online serious-game module that others can adopt for dental casting practice and assessment, rather than a general instructional element.
name: D-Casting module
product_description: A free online serious-game application within the OMEDT system for training and assessing dental and dental-technology students in lost-wax casting procedures.

why: The D-UPS program is a named, structured national training curriculum that others could adopt, rather than a general instructional element or merely an instructional finding.
name: Dutch Urology Practical Skills (D-UPS) training program
product_description: A national structured practical-skills curriculum for Dutch urology residents that combines theoretical preparation, simulator-based procedural practice, peer teaching, and evaluation.
